svg.title: NET-05-C — Explicit session consequence confirmation
svg.desc: Top-left wireframe coordinates. A centered blocking confirmation sits above one shared arena. The guest Leave confirmation represents the layout; host End uses the same structure. Opening input cannot also accept the confirmation.

g.text: Your players will be removed immediately and the match
Other players remain in the shared arena
ANNOTATIONS — not interface copy; preserve the existing design system and confirmation order
Read prompt → consequence → explicit action → Cancel. Confirm remains first; do not add initial Cancel focus.
Wrap copy inside the panel. Keep all buttons visible, separated by at least 8 px, with complete pointer targets.
Trap modal focus. Opening input, key repeat and held controller input cannot accept a newly opened panel.
Host variant: “End session for everyone?” / End session / Cancel. No implicit Return-to-End in active play.
Keep ≥16 px client inset at 1280×720 and 1280×900. Contract: docs/screens/network-match.md, NET-AC-016.
